images.alt: A woman in a white coat holds a prescription bag. Text reads: "Some prescriptions are getting... LOOOOOOOOONGER. Health New Zealand Te Whatu Ora. Ask your doctor if 12 month prescriptions are right for you."

post.text:
Longer prescriptions are here. From 1 February some people with stable, long-term health conditions may be able to get prescriptions that last up to 12 months. 

Ask your doctor if 12 month prescriptions are right for you.

Find out more: info.health.nz/prescriptions

source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
